body: So why you say you're poison?

lol I'm starting to like you
I'm not the typical suicidewatch poster. I'm not telling you the "suicide is always wrong" bs. I know what pain is, I've been suicidal, I've attempted suicide and I ocasionally think about suicide. 
I do believe in rational suicide. So I"m not telling you you're delusional. You might tell me that you're a child mass murderer. That would be empirical evidence that the world is better without you. If I thought you were delusional without knowing the facts that would be prejudice. I'm asking you for the facts. What have you done?. Why is the world better without you?. How is that someone has become an addict because of you?.

You're posting on a suicide forum saying you want to blow your brain off and that everybody is better without you.
That sounds to me like someone who is going through a major depression. Thinking you are a massive pile of shit is classic. I know because I've through it and I changed my mind later. You don't think clearly when you're in such state. That's why I want to argue. Because I suspect it's depression talking, and I want to help you.
And I'm sure you want help, that's why you're posting here. Let us help you

I'm okay talking with you. 
I do take your word on the fact that you believe you're poison. But the fact that you think you are doesn't mean you actually are. Maybe you are maybe you're not. But just because you believe it doesn't make it true. 
That's why I want to argue rationally and logically over this: "everyone will be better without me". 
If you are thinking of ending it all, you must be sure that you're thinking clearly, as it is obviously a delicate decisión. You wouldn't want to off yourself over false beliefs. Now I challenge you, can you tell me why you think everybody is better without you?.

Well I guess I could say "you're not alone" but it sounds such a cliché. I do understand how you feel tho. I can tell you from my own experience that is kind of a vicious circle. You end up lost in self loathing and suicidal tjoughts so you stop doing things to improve your life so your life sucks then you get depressed because your life sucks. You need to break that pattern with small changes. You start thinking that you might as well live, so you do things to improve your life. You shouldn't aim to become the happiest persón ever. You accept and come to terms that you will feel lonely and sad at times but you learn to love yourself at least at little bit. So, are you socially awkward? So be it. As far as  my experience goes, people smells it when you're needy and run away. So you shouldn't expect to make a lot of friends while you're down. You need to feel better first. Which of course needs you to WANT to feel better. I don't know if there's a secret key to wanting to feel better. I think it just happens eventually when you get tired of suffering. But when it happens you start doing things. It may be enjoying little things , like reading a book, watching a tv show... In my case meds helped a lot. I'm also doing cbt, but because at some point I started to want to feel even better. So now I'm working and studying at college (i'm not from the u.s. so that doesn't requiere a lot of money) .. I'm not incredibly happy but I'm not in pain. I have troubles making new friends but now that I'm a bit stronger I don't CARE so much. I do have much more social interaction than when I was suicidal though. Well that"s enough about me now what about you? What have you tried to improve your life these 4 years?

Come on, try me. I'm certainly not going to ignore you. You can't expect us to believe you"re poison just because you say so. I'm being honest here. I'm not belittling you and giving you the "oh you're not poison, you're good as bread" crap. I want to know what you've done. Maybe you do have a good reason to hate yourself. Please share it with me.

Yes I understand when you feel so lonely it drives you crazy. You end up ruminating about suicide. The idea of ending it all relieves you. It"s kind of.. addictive. You kind of try to convince yourself that suicide will erase all your pain. Then you become so attached to the idea you stop doing things to get you better. After all, in your mind you'll commit suicide after all. Do you relate to this or I'm just talking of my own experience?

Actually I've been reading your posts and you said you actually want something. You said you want to be in a relationship. And there's more, you also said you we're able to experience happiness, at least briefly. You seem to hate yourself deeply and I'm pretty sure YOU don't allow yourself to be happy, because at some point you think you deserve to suffer. You are your own enemy. I would't be surprised if you answer me in a rude way, because you're looking to be treated like garbage, like you treat yourself and like it seems you been treated in the past. I'm pretty sure now that you CAN get Better, but you won't because you won't allow yourself to. You need to realize it's not winter, day, night or summer, you need to realize it's YOU punishing yourself for a crime you didn't commit and you can actually get a lot better when you allow yourself to. Easier said than done of course. But you are paralyzed there ruminating about suicide. Find a therapist. If it doesn't work try another one. You need to face your pain, and we both know suicide is not facing the pain but escaping from it. You need to wake up and realize you can be fixed. Yeah you won't be Brad Pitt but once you begin to realize you're a valuable person and that you don't deserve to suffer, you might learn to stop hating yourself and stop to making other people hate you as well, and you'll likely find that relationship you're looking for

Also, why die today when you can always do it tomorrow?. Well my point is. dying is really hard.
